translated_title: PT Considers Breaking Its Alliance With Morena After the ‘Imposition’ of Verónica Díaz as Coordinator for Zacatecas
original_title: PT analiza romper alianza con Morena tras "imposición" de Verónica Díaz como coordinadora para Zacatecas
author: Alfredo Valadez Rodríguez
meta_description: Party of Labor leaders say Morena broke a deal and imposed Verónica Díaz, tied to the Monreal clan for 20 years, and may quit the 2027 Zacatecas coalition Monday.
